'''Lodani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] she was stationed on the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|''White Nova'']] during the [[Battle of the Foundry]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Lodani appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on the ''White Nova'', who begins the flashpoint "The Foundry."
